# COGIFY Technologies — cogify.me

> Sovereign, zero-telemetry native macOS workstations, Safari Web Extensions, and client-side web studios engineered by Shubham Sharma (Apple Developer ID #1643497398). 14 live products with 100% local execution, zero subscriptions ($0 forever for individual users), and zero cloud tracking.

## 6 Native macOS Workstations (100% Free • Signed & Notarized .DMG)
- [EmDoc PDF Workstation](https://cogify.me/products/emdoc): 5.0 MB native C++20 & Swift PDF editor, redactor, Bates stamper, form signer, compressor, and Apple Vision OCR engine (~45 MB RAM, $0 vs. Adobe Acrobat Pro $239.88/yr). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/EmDoc.dmg
- [LumenView — External Monitor Controller](https://cogify.me/lumenview): 7.8 MB native Swift & Metal 3 macOS external monitor utility with hardware I2C DDC/CI brightness/contrast/volume, HiDPI Retina scaling up to 240Hz, 3D .cube LUT calibration, and 60 FPS ScreenCaptureKit Virtual Displays ($0 vs. BetterDisplay $22 / Lunar $23). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/LumenView.dmg
- [Metricove — Menu Bar System Telemetry](https://cogify.me/metricove): 2.3 MB native Swift 6 & IOKit/SMC hardware monitor for Apple Silicon P/E-cores, GPU, ANE, thermal sensors, custom fan curves, and process telemetry (~11 MB RAM, $0 vs. iStat Menus $11.99). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/Metricove.dmg
- [NetGuard — Outbound Application Firewall](https://cogify.me/netguard): 3.8 MB native Apple NetworkExtension (`NEFilterDataProvider`) outbound firewall, live socket inspector, 3D Metal globe map, and 500k+ DNS sinkhole ($0 vs. Little Snitch $59). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/NetGuard.dmg
- [Klipora — Encrypted Clipboard & Bento Pasteboard](https://cogify.me/klipora): 3.1 MB native Swift & SQLite WAL clipboard manager with AES-256-GCM Vault, offline Apple Vision OCR, sequential Paste Queue, and 1Password/Bitwarden exclusion ($0 vs. Paste $29.99/yr). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/Klipora.dmg
- [Show Free Space — APFS Disk Space Analyzer](https://cogify.me/show-free-space): 4.2 MB native Swift menu bar disk monitor, interactive sunburst storage visualizer, Xcode/Docker developer cache cleaner, and WidgetKit widgets ($0 vs. DaisyDisk $9.99 / CleanMyMac X $39.95/yr). Direct DMG: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/ShowFreeSpace.dmg

## 2 Client-Side Web Studios
- [Marriage Biodata Maker Studio](https://cogify.me/biodata) (Live App: https://biodata.cogify.me): 242 cultural, regional & NRI A4 templates across 9 languages with 300-DPI PDF, Word (.docx), and PNG export.
- [SSB Stage-2 Test Practice Studio](https://cogify.me/ssb) (Live App: https://ssb.cogify.me): Complete Indian Armed Forces SSB Psychology (TAT, WAT, SRT, SDT), GTO Tasks, Personal Interview PIQ, and 15 OLQ simulator.

## 6 Native Safari Extensions (macOS, iOS & iPadOS)
- [Ad Blocker for Safari](https://cogify.me/ad-blocker): Native WebKit Content Blocker for ads, trackers, and cookie walls.
- [ReaderEasy](https://cogify.me/readereasy): Distraction-free Safari reader mode with Bionic reading, themes, and TTS.
- [WebClear](https://cogify.me/webclear): Per-site cookie, cache, LocalStorage cleaner, and URL tracker stripper.
- [WebLenses](https://cogify.me/weblenses): Live Core Web Vitals, DOM inspector, and security header auditor in Safari.
- [Element Hider](https://cogify.me/element-hider): Visual point-and-click DOM element blocker for Safari.
- [Colour Invert](https://cogify.me/invert): Smart dark mode and media-preserving color inversion for Safari.
